# Direct generic value transfers with declared exceptions

This independently authored provider binds one method formal at both its direct
input and result. Separate entries retain unchecked and checked exception
declarations. An opaque callback chooses the actual result independently of the
input. No extra context or array parameter supplies a binding.

The observer checks nulls, unrelated replacements, returned aliases, arrays,
callback order, snapshots, exact failures, checked exception timing, ignored
results and narrow casts. A constructor escapes before its ignored call and
stores its original class token afterward. Source and SDK profiles compile all
emitted Java8 units and preserve definitions, generic metadata, roles and
Exceptions. Wrong programs fail before recovery. Signature-only controls retain
Code and runtime descriptors while breaking the complete scoped relation.
